How the plan works

Ordered units are before returns and cancellations. Kept units produce item revenue. Refunds remove revenue and reverse ordinary Uzum sales fees. Packaging and delivery can still cost money once dispatched. Inventory write-offs apply only to the expected share you cannot resell.

Break-even volume uses expected contribution per ordered unit and keeps the entered period charges constant. Break-even list price varies price only. Price scenarios hold the order mix and period charges constant. Manual price bands can change the commission rate between scenarios.

The workbooks contain category rate snapshots. If your seller cabinet shows a price tier, promotion rule, eligibility limit, or a special contract rate, enter the effective rate or set up to three manual price bands. Price thresholds in this planner use the list price.
